watch.note: One watch per entity URL (playlist/show/episode/album/audiobook) — scope page; enumeration happens inside the capture via the API, not by link discovery. The harvest sandbox's `spotify` route (the app's client credentials, in the wiki's vault per machine) is needed for complete item lists; keyless capture degrades to a possibly-truncated list. Audio downloads only when the show publishes an open RSS feed; Spotify-exclusive/music/audiobook audio is captured as DRM references, never ripped. A non-URL request ("add episode 400 of X") asks the operator for the URL. Confined harvest reaches metadata and the RSS lookup; media download needs a host the unit cannot declare (the creator's own feed and enclosure hosts, different per show).
